channel.title: Handy Calcs pins
channel.description: Free calculators in English and Spanish.

item.title: Comprimir imagen a 100 KB, 50 KB o el peso que quieras (gratis y privado)
item.description: Reduce el peso de fotos JPG, PNG y WebP en segundos. Pon un límite como 100 KB o 50 KB. Gratis y sin subir nada: tus fotos no salen de tu dispositivo.

item.title: How to Split a Restaurant Bill Fairly With Friends
item.description: Fair ways to split a check: even split, pay for what you ordered, shared plates, drinks, tax and tip, plus tips to avoid awkward moments at the table. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Compress Image to 100KB, 50KB or Any Size (Free, Private)
item.description: Make JPG, PNG and WebP photos smaller in seconds. Set a target like 100KB or 50KB. Free, no upload: your photos never leave your device.

item.title: How to Scale a Recipe Up or Down (Without Ruining It)
item.description: How to double, halve or scale any recipe: the scaling factor, cups to tablespoons, eggs, pan sizes, baking times and oven temperature conversions. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Generador de códigos QR gratis (sin registro y no vence)
item.description: Crea un código QR para cualquier enlace o texto en un segundo. Gratis, sin registro, sin marca de agua y no vence nunca. Descárgalo en PNG o SVG.

item.title: How to Calculate a Discount and Sales Tax (Black Friday Math)
item.description: How to work out a sale price, "extra 20% off" stacked discounts, percent saved and sales tax, with simple examples and formulas. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.
